m1.text: I began employment at Caldriva in March 2016 as a catalog analyst. I did not save the exact start day.

m2.text: My friend Deni works at Jezuno and lent me a camping stove.

m3.text: I opened my own freelance business Oskena Desk in 2020 while keeping my salaried job.

m4.text: On 12 May 2021, Caldriva renamed itself Evorali. My catalog analyst employment continued without any break or new hire.

m5.text: Read a local-news piece about Evorali sponsoring a public garden.

m6.text: I left Evorali in August 2022; the exact day is lost. My next salaried employer was Jezuno, starting in September 2022 as a catalog lead.

m7.text: I closed Oskena Desk in 2024, but saved only the year of closure and the year it opened. Jezuno remains my sole salaried employer.

m1.text: My salaried job as a training assistant at Bexoria ran from 2015 to 2018. I have no month or day for my departure.

m2.text: Bought a language workbook from Solquessa.

m3.text: My Language sabbatical covered all of 2019 and 2020, with no employment or self-employment. Bexoria was my last employer before that break, and I took no other work between leaving it and the break.

m4.text: I launched my own freelance business Istravo Works in March 2021. I cannot recover the day. It was my first work after the sabbatical.

m5.text: Through Istravo Works, I served Solquessa as a training-materials client from April 2021 to November 2022. I never worked as an employee of Solquessa.

m6.text: My friend Omi works at Tazunel and joined me for a museum visit.

m7.text: Tazunel was another Istravo Works client from 2023 to 2024, never my employer. Istravo Works has operated continuously since March 2021 and is still my only work. I have not recorded any jobs before 2015.
